properties.headline: Wildfire with IMMEDIATE EVACUATION for portions of Comanche County east of Indiahoma.
properties.description: At 4pm (1600)  a large and destructive wildfire was burning out of control east of Indiahoma and spreading rapidly northward. Wildfires can damage or destroy structures and can harm or kill people and animals. For your safety EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY to to the north towards Cache.
properties.instruction:
Those between Cache Road/Holsey Acres Road and Rogers Lane to the north and south and NW Big Bow Road and NW 197th Street  should LEAVE this area NOW to avoid injury or death. Do not delay to pack belongings. Reunification Center is setting up at the New Life Assembly of God at 501 W B Ave  Cache  OK.
Roads in the area may be impacted by fire and smoke. Never drive into heavy smoke. SLOW DOWN & MOVE OVER for emergency vehicles.

CMAMtext: Comanche Co EM: EVACUATION ORDER for Indiahoma for a wildfire. LEAVE NOW to the North.
CMAMlongtext: Comanche County EM: A large and destructive wildfire was burning out of control east of Indiahoma and spreading rapidly northward. Wildfires can damage or destroy structures and can harm or kill people and animals. For your safety, EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY to the north towards New Life Assembly in Cache.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 29 at 10:11AM CDT until August 30 at 9:10AM CDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Illinois...Indiana...

Wabash River at Vincennes

...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in
Illinois...Indiana...

Wabash River at Hutsonville Legacy Power Plant Site

Wabash River at Riverton

.Minor flooding continues on the Wabash River from Hutsonville down
to Vincennes. The river has crested. Flooding should come to an end
on the Wabash over the weekend.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Wabash River at Vincennes.

* WHEN...Until Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 17.0 feet, Considerable agricultural flooding extends
from just north of the junction of Illinois 33 with Business 50 to
the St. Francesville, Illinois area.  River Road from Lincoln
Memorial Bridge to Billett Rd is impassable.  Extensive seep water
forms behind Illinois levees extending from Russellville to U.S.
Highway 50.  Flooding of agricultural land begins in Knox County
Indiana west of the railroad extending for the Oaktown area to the
north side of Vincennes.  Extensive flooding of Small Creek.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:45 AM CDT /10:45 AM EDT/ Saturday the stage was 17.1 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 10.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 9:45 AM CDT /10:45 AM EDT/ Saturday was 18.1 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage late
this evening and continue falling to 4.4 feet Tuesday, September
08.
- Flood stage is 16.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/ind.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 1015 PM CDT /1115
PM EDT/.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 29 at 5:14PM EDT until August 29 at 6:15PM EDT by NWS Key West FL
properties.description:
SMWKEY

The National Weather Service in Key West has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Gulf of America including Dry Tortugas and Rebecca Shoal Channel...

* Until 615 PM EDT.

* At 514 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located over Pulaski Shoal
Light. The strong thunderstorm was nearly stationary.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...National Weather Service Meteorologist.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, frequent lightning, and heavy downpours.

* Locations in the warning include...
Pulaski Shoal Light, Fort Jefferson, and Dry Tortugas.
properties.instruction:
Prepare for wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, steep and fast-building
seas, frequent lightning, and blinding downpours. Stay low or go
below, and make sure all on board are wearing life jackets.

SVRTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern Santa Cruz County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 300 PM MST.

* At 222 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located near Elgin, moving
west at 10 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Sonoita and Elgin.

This includes the following highways...
Route 82 between mile markers 23 and 40...and near mile marker 44.
Route 83 between mile markers 18 and 36.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.description:

* WHERE...South Central Carbon County in central Utah...
Northwestern Emery County in central Utah...
Southeastern Sanpete County in central Utah...

* WHEN...Until 545 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 251 PM MDT, emergency management reported high flows on
Cottonwood Creek from heavy rainfall, with water approaching the
bridge on Main Street in Orangeville. Flooding is already
occurring. Up to 1 inch of rain has fallen according to radar
estimates, with the most rainfall updrainage from Castle Dale and
Huntington.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Huntington, Wellington, Sunnyside, Clawson, Castle Dale, Ferron,
Orangeville, East Carbon, Cleveland and Elmo.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 29 at 3:20PM MDT until August 29 at 4:30PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
At 320 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing heavy
rain across portions of the San Rafael Swell including Goblin Valley,
Little Wildhorse, Crack, Chute, Ding, Dang, Muddy Creek and all slot
canyons and dry washes in and near southern Emery and north central
Wayne County. Between 0.25 and 0.75 inches of rain have fallen. Flash
flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of slot canyons, normally
dry washes, streams, creeks and rivers.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Goblin Valley, Little Wildhorse, Crack, Chute, Ding, Dang, Muddy
Creek and all slot canyons and dry washes in and near southern
Emery and north central Wayne County.
properties.instruction:

deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 29 at 12:02PM MST until August 29 at 3:00PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Havasu Creek basin in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 300 PM MST.

* At 1202 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Havasu Creek basin, primarily from Supai
northward to the Colorado River. Between 0.5 and 0.75 inches of
rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.25 to 0.5 inches
are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Havasu Creek basin from
Supai to the Colorado River.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Havasu Creek basin.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Coconino County including Havasu Creek from
Supai northward.

This includes the Colorado River between river miles 156 and 158.

This includes the following swimming holes...
All swimming holes on Havasu Creek near Supai.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Little Coyote Canyon, Colorado River and Havasu Creek.
properties.instruction:
Campers and hikers should hustle to higher ground immediately! Stay
away from creeks and washes!

Some campsites will be flooded. Campers may be stranded in portions
of the campground.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 3:00 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 3:00 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.
